title: COMPL-AI Framework: A Technical Interpretation and LLM Benchmarking Suite for the EU Artificial Intelligence Act
reasoning: The paper is explicitly structured around evaluating the 'six key ethical principles' of the EU AI Act. It includes benchmarking suites for ethics-related categories such as 'Diversity, Non-discrimination, and Fairness', and specifically utilizes the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) which includes religious and social bias testing.
